name: Lanaeste
source: [url=/c94628]Sophia's[/url] mother. Unlike Sophia, she is a pure-blood vampire. She raised Sophia to not be ashamed of the aristocrats of the vampire world. Like her daughter, she is not active during the daytime and prefers coming out at night. She has a mild-mannered personality, but she also has a strict side that comes with being part of a race that rules at the top echelons of demon-kind (she also shows a silly side when with Sophia). Vampire maids are always serving at her side.
